title: Project-local planner usage skill and cross-harness loading
summary: Create a complete project-local planner usage skill, keep its command inventory current, and load it consistently across harnesses.
description: Current state: `plugins/_shared/planner-skill.md.in:1` contains the shared MCP-oriented `/planner` routing guide and `plugins/claude-code/skills/planner/SKILL.md:1` is its generated Claude Code copy, but the command inventory may drift and no canonical `.planner/SKILL.md` exists. `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts` does not seed or load a project-local planner skill, while `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts`, `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts`, and `packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts` carry overlapping operational guidance. Create a harness-agnostic canonical skill source, audit every current Pi/MCP command and lifecycle outcome, seed `.planner/SKILL.md` without timestamps, load it automatically for agent context across Pi and MCP-compatible clients, and keep generated plugin guidance synchronized. Canonical unmodified copies may be upgraded deterministically; project-customized copies must be preserved and reported as drift rather than overwritten. The skill must distinguish planner usage instructions from Project Guidelines, remain agent-facing rather than leaking internal rules into the human recap, and cover discovery/priority, composite references, context reads, task lifecycle, mutations, description fallback, handoffs, Web UI supervisor boundaries, and troubleshooting. Preserve plan-core harness independence and existing public contracts unless additions are explicitly compatible.

acceptedDecisions.title: Canonical managed project-local planner skill
acceptedDecisions.decision: The canonical cross-harness planner operating guide is owned by @agent-plan/core and materialized as a timestamp-free managed `.planner/SKILL.md`. Unmodified managed copies upgrade deterministically by body hash on explicit planner load; customized copies are preserved and produce actionable drift diagnostics. Pi injects the guide as agent-only system context and MCP planner-load returns it as agent-only structured context while the human recap text remains clean.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: One plan-core source prevents Pi, MCP, CLI, and plugin guidance from drifting, while a content hash distinguishes safe automatic upgrades from project-authored customizations. Agent-only loading makes the guide available in every supported harness without leaking operational instructions into user-facing recaps.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: Canonical source: packages/plan-core/planner-skill.md. Runtime synchronization: packages/plan-core/src/planner-skill.ts and PlanStore.syncPlannerSkill(). Generated mirrors: plugins/_shared/planner-skill.md.in and plugins/claude-code/skills/planner/SKILL.md via scripts/sync-plugins.cjs. Inventory and lifecycle regressions must remain green.

completionCriteria: `.planner/SKILL.md` contains the complete current planner usage contract and public command inventory.
Pi and MCP-compatible agent flows load the project-local skill automatically without exposing internal guidance in human recaps.
Canonical unmodified copies upgrade deterministically while customized copies are preserved with actionable drift reporting.
Cross-harness, generated-output, persistence, and inventory-drift tests pass.

tasks.title: Audit, publish, and auto-load the project-local planner usage skill
tasks.description:
Implement the approved project-local planner skill contract. Audit the complete public command/tool inventories in `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts`, `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts`, `packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts`, and `test/surfaces.mjs`; reconcile them with `plugins/_shared/planner-skill.md.in:1` and the generated `plugins/claude-code/skills/planner/SKILL.md:1`. Add a harness-agnostic canonical source in plan-core and integrate `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts` so new planners receive timestamp-free `.planner/SKILL.md`. Existing canonical, unmodified copies must upgrade deterministically when Agent Plan changes; customized copies must be preserved and return actionable drift diagnostics. Wire automatic agent-context loading for Pi and MCP-compatible clients without exposing internal operational guidance in the human recap. The skill must precisely document planner activation, feature/phase/task discovery and visible priorities, composite references, lifecycle-first demand-driven reads, Project Guidelines, start/pause/switch/resume/complete, mutation/read-back rules, `.planner/docs/` oversized-description fallback, Web UI supervisor exemptions, typed denial recovery, and the exhaustive handoff protocol that the following F020 phase will enforce. Add inventory-drift, init/upgrade/customization, cross-harness loading, generated-output, and no-user-recap-leak regression tests. Preserve user customizations, exact source-code English, and plan-core harness independence.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented the canonical cross-harness planner usage skill and verified it end to end. `packages/plan-core/planner-skill.md` is now the single English-language operating guide with complete Pi/MCP inventories, lifecycle-first demand-driven reads, Project Guidelines, visible priorities, composite refs, typed denial recovery, mutation/read-back and `.planner/docs/` fallback rules, Web UI supervisor boundaries, task pause/switch/resume/complete behavior, and a resume-proof handoff protocol including bounded inline content plus linked supporting docs. `packages/plan-core/src/planner-skill.ts` adds deterministic SHA-256 managed-copy rendering and synchronization; `PlanStore.init()` seeds timestamp-free `.planner/SKILL.md`, explicit loads safely upgrade unmodified copies, and customized copies are preserved with actionable drift diagnostics. `packages/plan-core/package.json` ships the canonical Markdown asset. Pi `/planner load` and `planner-load` synchronize the copy and inject it only into hidden/system agent context; MCP `planner-load` returns it in agent-only structuredContent while keeping recap text clean. `packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts` now generates Claude command guidance from the canonical core skill, and `scripts/sync-plugins.cjs` mirrors that source into `plugins/_shared/planner-skill.md.in` and `plugins/claude-code/skills/planner/SKILL.md`. Added `packages/plan-core/test/planner-skill.test.mjs` and `test/planner-skill-inventory.test.mjs`, plus Pi/MCP/CLI regressions for managed init/upgrade/customization, complete public tool and slash-command inventories, cross-harness load injection, generated-copy parity, package inclusion, and no human-recap leakage. Verification: `pnpm check` passed; `node scripts/sync-plugins.cjs --check` passed; focused new/cross-harness tests passed; `pnpm test:coverage` passed 484/484 Node tests and 80/80 Web UI tests with FINAL coverage 85.92% lines, 73.84% branches, 80.61% functions; `npm pack --dry-run` confirmed `planner-skill.md` and `dist/planner-skill.*` are published; `git diff --check` passed. No commit or push was performed. The separate verified handoff-list/show transport overflow and structured-content defects were recorded for P089(F020)/T352 rather than mixed into this task.
